name: Session Chair
job_description: (Dummy) Introduces each speaker, keeps time, and moderates Q&A. Agrees on time signals with the [[Room Volunteer]] and takes remote questions from the [[Zoom Volunteer]].

name: Room Volunteer
job_description: (Dummy) Owns the physical room: microphones, time cards, and the audience queue. Reports problems to the [[Session Chair]].

name: Zoom Volunteer
job_description: (Dummy) Runs the Zoom meeting for remote attendees and presenters. Watches the Zoom chat and relays questions to the [[Session Chair]].

name: Poster Volunteer
job_description: (Dummy) Keeps the poster area in order: boards, numbering, pins, and helping presenters find their spot.
